judge.rationale: Variant A offers direct assistance by requesting confirmation details via DM, which can help resolve the issue but risks privacy concerns and is not fully aligned with policy that advises caution with private data. It is helpful but factual support is moderate due to this risk. Escalation is appropriate given the unresolved access issue. Variant B provides comprehensive, factual guidance aligned with official policy, suggesting app and website options and alternative contact methods without requesting private info, making it the most factually supported and helpful. Escalation is not needed as it guides the customer to self-service and support. Variant C is brief and directs the customer to official channels for secure review, which is factually correct and safe but less helpful due to lack of detail. It appropriately escalates due to the service access problem. Tone is polite and empathetic across all variants.
